mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip (user_id, title, trip_date, prompt, start_time, adults, seniors, children, budget, pace, district_ids, must_poi_ids, avoid_poi_ids, interests, total_cost) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{tripDate}, #{prompt}, #{startTime}, #{adults}, #{seniors}, #{children}, #{budget}, #{pace}, #{districtIds}, #{mustPoiIds}, #{avoidPoiIds}, #{interests}, #{totalCost})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.trip_date, t.total_cost, t.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.poi_id) FROM trip_item i JOIN poi p ON p.id = i.poi_id WHERE i.trip_id = t.id AND p.type = 'SCENIC') AS stop_count, (SELECT p.illustration FROM trip_item i JOIN poi p ON p.id = i.poi_id WHERE i.trip_id = t.id AND p.type = 'SCENIC' ORDER BY i.seq LIMIT 1) AS cover FROM trip t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
